fun_facts: Chase Brown was born in London, Ontario, two minutes before his identical twin, Sydney; they played football together in peewee leagues.
As a freshman at Western Michigan, Chase Brown gained 352 rushing yards and returned 12 kickoffs.
In 2022, Chase Brown led the Power 5 in rushing with 1,643 yards and scored 10 touchdowns.
Chase Brown became Illinois' first running back to be a Doak Walker Award finalist and finished as the school's second-leading career rusher, with 3,558 yards.

Born two minutes apart on March 21, 2000, in London, Ontario, the two brothers played together in pee wee leagues and later became football stars together for the [Illinois Fighting Illini](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/356/illinois-fighting-illini) .
